execution_evidence.raw_source_text: The Turtles entered when price exceeded the specified breakout level by a single tick. For a System 1 long breakout, one Unit was used to initiate the position. The source describes adding Units as the position moved in favor by 1/2 N, subject to the stated Unit and exposure limits.
execution_evidence.captured_execution_rule: Execute the S1 long breakout when price exceeds the preceding 20-day high by one tick; initiate with one Unit. Subsequent unit additions follow the source-defined 1/2 N favorable-move rule and exposure limits.

market_conditions.additional_source_defined_filter: ignore S1 signal when the last breakout would have resulted in a winning trade
